arguments.where_clause: transactions.merchant_id IN (SELECT id FROM merchants WHERE mcc = 5311)
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction whose merchant is coded MCC 5311 (department stores), regardless of amount, card or channel.
assumptions: Department stores means merchants whose mcc is exactly 5311, as you specified; I did not check the mcc_codes description for that code.
The rule matches on merchant category only, with no amount, card-type or channel condition.
